query: SELECT p.id, p.ventureId, p.name, p.description, p.portfolioType, p.portfolioStatus, v.name as ventureName, v.sector FROM portfolios p LEFT JOIN ventures v ON p.ventureId = v.id ORDER BY p.ventureId; SELECT o.id, o.portfolioId, o.ventureId, o.name, o.description, o.offeringType, o.offeringStatus, o.trl, o.revenueModel FROM offerings o ORDER BY o.ventureId, o.portfolioId;
